scripts.title: Tower defense games script
scripts.features:
Games i know are supported:
Multiverse tower defense
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local args = {
    [1] = "TowerName",
    [2] = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
}

ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Functions"):WaitForChild("SpawnTower"):InvokeServer(unpack(args))
